scope: Independent main-text comparison. Supplement access was separately attempted and closed by root without panel/legend recovery; main-text author reports are not direct supplement verification. No experiments or simulations were conducted.

sources.version: PMC author manuscript linked to the final publication; not independently compared with the publisher-formatted version of record
sources.access: Main text and main-figure legends read; supplemental panels and legends not recovered or inspected
Complete cached XML read and hash checked; supplemental-file contents not inspected in this comparison

locators: What is already sufficient to proceed

novelty_labels.final_revision: Present in reviewed final-publication manuscript, absent or substantively different in reviewed preprint main text; does not imply an independent project
novelty_labels.preprint_fact_new_to_summary: Already in cached preprint; improve extraction but do not claim new final-publication biology
novelty_labels.already_round7: Controlling interpretation already recorded in Round 7
novelty_labels.source_discordance: Preserve disagreement or ambiguity; do not silently reconcile
novelty_labels.inference: Audit interpretation rather than an author-reported result

records.fact: PMC author manuscript linked to final publication; same research project as the preprint.
records.interpretation: Use final-publication author manuscript as the access description. This is improved access and a version comparison, not independent replication. Publisher pagination does not prove publisher-layout inspection.

records.fact: Methods name N/TERT-2G and baricitinib during clone generation; Results equates N/TERT and Ker-CT.
records.preprint: N/TERT-2G and clone-generation baricitinib already explicit; Results uses hTERT/Ker-CT.

locators.F: Methods: Cell lines and culture, lines 132-137; Results: Construction and validation, line 190

records.interpretation: Retain published identity conflict. Do not substitute an ATCC Ker-CT parent without declaring a different system. Historical baricitinib exposure is a provenance item, not evidence of ongoing assay exposure, carryover or a demonstrated JAK-specific confound. Main text does not specify a washout history sufficient to establish those claims.

records.fact: A second heterozygous clone has different SPCA1 expression and impaired spreading.
records.preprint: Main text describes single- and bi-allelic knockout models without reporting a second independent heterozygous clone.

locators.F: Results: Construction and validation, lines 191-204, especially 192; SPCA1 is required for actin-mediated spreading, line 228; cited Fig. S1a-e

records.genotype_limit: Monoallelic/biallelic categories and sequencing validation are reported. Exact edited allele strings/HGVS for each clone were not recovered from reviewed main text; these are engineered knockouts, not demonstrated patient-variant knock-ins.
records.evidence_level: Main-text author report referring to S1; S1 panels and legends remain uninspected
records.interpretation: The additional clone reduces a clone-specific explanation for the reported baseline phenotype. It does not make every endpoint or rescue independently replicated. Without direct S1 inspection, the detailed clone-specific endpoint map remains unverified.

records.fact: Three independently grown cultures; separate treatment/processing, shared measurement session. Selected legends count cells.
records.preprint: Statistics describes three technical replicates unless the legend specifies otherwise.

locators.F: Methods: Statistical Analysis, lines 185-187; Fig. 1 legend, lines 199-201; Fig. 3 legend, lines 234-236; Fig. 7 legend, lines 244-248

records.interpretation: This is a changed account of replication, not proof that the data were independently repeated after preprint posting. Cultures are nested within clonal lines; cells/images are nested measurements. The manuscript does not supply a complete mapping from all displayed cells to culture-level aggregates, so avoid asserting that every reported imaging test uses a culture-level independent unit. No reanalysis was conducted.

records.fact: SPCA1 expression precedes replating; rescue endpoints include spreading, insulin uptake and Golgi features.
records.preprint: Same temporal ordering and endpoint classes.

locators.F: Methods: DNA transfection, line 139; Results: Transgenic hSPCA1 rescue, lines 298-300; Fig. 7 legend, lines 244-248
locators.P: sec S13/p[1]; sec S9/p[1]; fig F7/caption

records.interpretation: Causal correction before the endpoint challenge does not establish treatment of an already failed mature epidermal barrier. The separate attachment endpoint must be assessed on its own; do not generalize the transfection result to delayed pharmacological repair.

records.fact: Dispase/mechanical challenge shows baseline fragility; Discussion describes weak CDN1163 attachment improvement.
records.preprint: No dispase or Cell Attachment Assay occurs in the reviewed XML main text.

locators.F: Methods: Cell Attachment Assay, lines 168-170; Results: junctional phenotypes, line 209; Discussion, line 310; cited Fig. S4
locators.P: Complete XML main-text term check; Methods sections S11-S24

records.supplement_status: Root closed the bounded supplement access lane without recovering S4 panels or legend. Its panel counts, effect magnitude and analysis are not established by this audit.
records.evidence_level: Main-text author report only for weak attachment improvement; direct supplement verification unavailable
records.interpretation: Update the model scope beyond spreading alone. A baseline functional deficit and an author-described weak drug effect remain distinct from a qualified full-repair positive control. Do not report no functional endpoint existed; do not upgrade weak attachment improvement to full barrier restoration.

records.fact: CDN1163 improves spreading/Golgi/pAKT while junctional recovery remains limited.
records.preprint: Rescue narrative is broader and lacks the final junctional limitation.

locators.F: Results: Transgenic hSPCA1 or Ca2+-ATPase agonist, lines 301-306; Discussion, line 310; cited Figs. S2g and S9

records.interpretation: The final-versus-preprint narrowing is real, but Round 7 already captured the junctional-morphology caveat. Newly readable details strengthen endpoint-specific qualification; they do not create new clinical efficacy evidence or independently validate a complete-barrier comparator.

records.fact: Figure 7(i-j) caption says control keratinocytes; Results assigns spreading rescue to heterozygotes.
records.preprint: The same caption/body wording difference is present.
records.interpretation: Use figure-panel labels to map each comparison before extracting a genotype-specific quantitative rescue effect. Do not resolve the ambiguity by assumption. This is an audit flag, not a new biological result.

records.fact: Results assigns reduced receptors to both mutants; Figure 6 legend retains near-normal heterozygous IR.
records.preprint: Results describes near-normal heterozygous insulin-receptor expression.

locators.F: Results: Insulin signaling pathway, line 279; Fig. 6 legend, lines 286-287; cited Fig. S1f-g and S7

records.interpretation: Retain clone- and endpoint-specific distinctions. Do not create a universal receptor-loss assertion from the final Results sentence. This peripheral ambiguity is not a reason to expand the bounded sprint.

development_assessment.classification: inference from source audit and existing Round 7 decision
development_assessment.rux_clinical_gate: Unchanged: an independently qualified keratinocyte model is optional before controlled clinical proof of useful lesion control with the exact marketed cream.
development_assessment.why: The question supported by the human dossier is clinical control; this model addresses selected cell-autonomous mechanisms. A model result cannot replace clinical randomization or establish a proprietary formulation advantage.
development_assessment.optional_module_trigger: Use only if resolving mechanism changes article, population, combination, exposure or contribution claim.
development_assessment.positive_control_rule: Qualify a comparator for the endpoint actually rescued. Do not promote marker/spreading rescue or weak sheet-attachment improvement to demonstrated mature-barrier recovery.
development_assessment.negative_result_rule: A negative immune-free keratinocyte result cannot veto a clinically useful anti-inflammatory mechanism.

closed_access_lane.metadata_status: Primary Figshare landing reachable according to root; child did not independently retrieve it
closed_access_lane.download_status: Root reports public download and exact indexed-source attempts failed; stop further route attempts in this sprint
closed_access_lane.scope_consequence: Preserve the main-text reports while leaving supplemental denominators, effect sizes and panel-specific comparisons unverified.

unresolved_at_closeout: Exact S4 attachment comparisons, replication and magnitude; Discussion's weak-effect description is an author report, not a quantified independent extraction.
S1 panel-specific mapping of each independent heterozygous clone to endpoints; do not generalize to replicated pharmacological rescue.
Figure 7 caption/body genotype wording and Figure 6 receptor wording are retained as source ambiguities.
Exact edited alleles, identity authentication and clone-generation drug washout history remain unverified.
